headline: AED 46.8 billion in Sharjah real estate market transactions over 9 months
summary: Sharjah's real estate market recorded AED 46.8 billion in transactions over nine months, a 14% rise. Twenty-two new projects were registered during the period.
why: Real estate transaction volumes are a key gauge of demand and investment activity in the United Arab Emirates property sector.
